audit.whatIsWrong: content.spikes[0].text and content.whys[1] both attribute the root to Swain's W ('W Nevermove' / 'his W root and E detain'), but per the kit W is Vision of Empire (damage/slow/reveal) and E is Nevermove, the ability that roots then pulls.
audit.why: Kit data: W = Vision of Empire, E = Nevermove ('roots enemies it hits... can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer'). The root-and-pull is entirely on E.
audit.corrected: Both fields rewritten to credit E Nevermove alone for the root-pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[N].side disagrees with content.win[N] on 6 of 7 rows: full says 'Skill' where content already says 'Swain' (rows 0,1,2,3,5,6), and full says 'Swain' at row 4 where content already says 'Pyke'.
audit.why: The two layers must name the same side. Content's whys already explain a kit-grounded Swain-favoured early/mid lane (range poke, soul-fragment sustain, Nevermove lockdown) flipping to Pyke only at level 6 (R executes before Demonic Ascension ramps healing) — the full layer's 'Skill' rows were never updated to match, and row 4's side was left on the wrong name entirely.
audit.corrected: phases[0,1,2,3,5,6].side -> 'Swain' with matching whys; phases[4].side -> 'Pyke' (why already fits).

audit.why: Power spikes correctly keyed: level 6 R execute window before Demonic Ascension ramps his healing, first-item Liandry's/Nevermove poke favouring him, late-game tanky self-sustain beating a solo execute.
